questions.qtext: Pointing to a photograph of a boy Rashid said, “He is the son of the only son of my mother. “How is Rashid related to that boy?
questions.solution:
(c)
The boy in the photograph is the only son of the son of Rashid’s mother. i.e. the son of Rashid.
Hence, Rashid is the father.

questions.qtext: What is the sum of the largest and the smallest 4-digit numbers made by using single digit prime numbers (without repetition)?
questions.solution:
(d)
Single digit prime numbers are 2, 3, 5, 7
Largest number formed is 7532
Smallest number formed 2357
Their sum will be 9889
